seoTitle: 🫴 Palm Up Hand Emoji Meaning - What Does 🫴 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the palm up hand emoji 🫴 really means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 🫴 Palm Up Hand emoji was added in Unicode 14 (2021) and is drawn as a yellow hand with the palm facing upward, fingers together, in an offering or 'I don't know' gesture. The visual cue reads instantly as offering, 'I don't know,' or the visible-shrugging-coded tag. By 2026 🫴 has become the go-to emoji for the offering reaction, the visible-'I do not know what to tell you' tag, and the palm-up-shrug default.

In modern chat 🫴 does very specific work. People send it as a literal palm-up-offering feeling, as the visible 'I do not know' tag, or as the shrugging-palm-up default. The palm-up-fingers-together is the visual cue that the message is offering or shrugging-coded. Writers should pick 🫴 when the read is 'I don't know' or offering, and avoid it when the read is different — 🤷 fits better for the universal shrug coded default.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
🫴 lands on a friend's 'I don't know what to tell you' message, in a work channel where someone is shrugging or offering, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is reacting with palm-up-coded content. The palm-up-fingers-together anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 🫴 reads as the universal 'I don't know' tag and the palm-up-offering default. On X the emoji punctuates offering-coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 🤷 for the layered palm-up-and-shrug stack and with 🤲 for the layered palm-up pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 🫴 in any context where the read is purely shrug universal — 🤷 fits better. Avoid 🫴 in ironic contexts where the offering is faked — 🙄 fits better there.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 🫴 on an offering message, mirror with a sentence that engages the question. The palm-up chain needs an answer.

If 🫴 lands as the 'I don't know' default, reply with a sentence that engages the question. And if you want to send 🫴 yourself, pair it with the moment so the offering read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 🫴 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 🫴 means offering, 'I don't know,' or palm-up shrug. The palm-up-fingers-together is the visual cue that the message is offering or shrugging-coded.

faqs.question: What does 🫴 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: From a guy or anyone, 🫴 carries the same offering read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: Is 🫴 passive aggressive?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. 🫴 can read as visible-'I have nothing' in a passive context. Watch the surrounding context for the read.

faqs.question: What does 🫴 mean at work?
faqs.answer: In Slack, 🫴 reads as the 'I am offering this' or 'I do not know' tag. Pair with a clarifying sentence so the channel stays useful.
